scope: 53 grouped source gaps; 005 and 006 are superseded

entries.title: Complete product and internal API operation contracts
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: The local operator uses a listed preparation or teacher action. The response uses its named schema, status, and atomic effect.
entries.negative_acceptance: An operation has an unknown field, stale revision, or unknown action. The API returns the declared error without a partial successful result.

entries.title: Public and private transport projections
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: A frozen submitted attempt requests its result. The response can show the exact full key under the selected disclosure policy.
entries.negative_acceptance: An unsubmitted attempt or blind review requests a hidden field. The serializer omits it from payloads, errors, and media metadata.

entries.title: Complete persistent entity and constraint model
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A new domain document and its reference nodes commit. Its head, references, and audit event share one database transaction.
entries.negative_acceptance: A reference points to another case or missing document. The operation cannot commit a healthy record.

entries.title: Database and object-store commit protocol
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: Upload and read-back agree. The final owning transaction links the private immutable asset.
entries.negative_acceptance: The process stops between upload and link. Recovery reports an orphan or pending reservation and never publishes missing bytes.

entries.title: Case lifecycle transition and guard table
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: A verified case has matching final approvals and valid grants. Publication commits the same content and audio digests.
entries.negative_acceptance: A quarantined case is retired. The unresolved quarantine flag remains and final evaluation stays blocked.

entries.title: Attempt and evaluation recovery transition table
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: An expired evaluation receives explicit recovery. The epoch increases and the exact answer, case, and policy stay fixed.
entries.negative_acceptance: A delayed provider response arrives under a stale epoch or after the deadline. The result is retained as failed evidence and cannot become final.

entries.title: Dispute and adjudicated result revision records
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: The operator selects affected historical attempts after a reviewed key correction. New revisions use an explicit old-to-new unit map.
entries.negative_acceptance: A replacement recording differs from the heard asset. The application cannot rescore the old listening attempt as though that recording was heard.

entries.title: Independent blind-listening annotation contract
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A genuine reviewer submits observations. Their hash and time freeze before key correspondence becomes available.
entries.negative_acceptance: The reviewer already saw the key or changes a submitted observation. The evidence cannot count as an original independent blind annotation.

entries.title: Reviewer independence and qualification records
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: Two eligible people independently review final audio and resolve findings. Their actual final approvals can satisfy the human gate.
entries.negative_acceptance: Two names describe one person, competence is unsupported, or the author reviews their own case. Publication cannot count those records as independent approvals.

entries.title: Teacher-answer gold annotation data contract
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: Annotators label a real frozen answer before model output. Their original labels and final correspondence remain separate.
entries.negative_acceptance: A generated answer or model-derived label is presented as independent human gold. It cannot satisfy heldout evidence.

entries.title: Detection-event boundaries and overlapping category resolution
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: Two repairs share a span but either repair leaves the other defect. The reviewed key retains two independent units with the rationale.
entries.negative_acceptance: Two labels describe the same repair or equally supported primary domains remain unresolved. The application cannot inflate opportunities or choose a primary domain arbitrarily.

entries.title: Frozen English/Russian aliases and taxonomy ancestors
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: The teacher supplies one registered unambiguous term. The mapper uses that exact ancestor or leaf identity.
entries.negative_acceptance: A term maps to multiple entries or a different registry version. The affected category decision remains unresolved.

entries.title: Severity assignment and fixed weight binding
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: Reviewers justify the context-specific severity under the fixed rubric. The immutable case records the corresponding weight.
entries.negative_acceptance: An evaluator changes weight after it sees an answer. The score input fails the fixed-policy guard.

entries.title: Rated difficulty evidence protocol
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: The complete study evidence meets the frozen band rule. The display cites that study and its population.
entries.negative_acceptance: The interval crosses bands or the sample is insufficient. The application keeps unrated and does not substitute author intuition or learner CEFR.

entries.title: Variety, register and judgment consistency table
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: The public task establishes the relevant constraint and reviewers support the target judgment. The unit can enter the declared error population.
entries.negative_acceptance: The only basis is a hidden accent preference or an incompatible context label. The case cannot publish that unit as a true error.

entries.title: Claim identity, extraction partition and completeness
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: All exact spans and coverage cells agree with the frozen answer. The server assigns reproducible persistent identities.
entries.negative_acceptance: A source quote is fabricated, an assertion is omitted, or identical spans carry conflicting interpretations. The extraction cannot enter completed scoring.

entries.title: Fragment consolidation, duplicate and retraction normalization
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A later explicit retraction withdraws an earlier assertion. The final endorsed group retains both clauses and the retraction evidence.
entries.negative_acceptance: Two unretracted repairs conflict or a relation forms a cycle. The group requires review rather than best-of or last-write credit.

entries.title: Evaluator and cross-schema conditional truth tables
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A supplied correction, selected option, proposition sets, and verdict agree with the same source and unit. The tuple enters normalization.
entries.negative_acceptance: A model reports accepted credit without supplied text, a foreign proposition, or an unresolved component in a resolved decision. The application rejects the tuple.

entries.title: Approved rationale registry and explanation-null binding
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A rationale ID resolves to the reviewed language-specific unit record. Feedback can cite its exact text.
entries.negative_acceptance: A correction option is used as an explanation option or the rationale belongs to another language/version. The reference is rejected.

entries.title: Semantic decisions to deterministic rubric and scorer input
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: Required proposition findings resolve without forbidden assertions. Code calculates the exact satisfied-count fraction.
entries.negative_acceptance: A supplied response includes a forbidden assertion or a plausible novel alternative. The first receives zero under the fixed rubric; the second requires review.

entries.title: Mapper/auditor comparison equality contract
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: Record order differs but all score-relevant fields and evidence meanings agree. The difference does not change the score.
entries.negative_acceptance: The target, option, proposition credit, stance source, or exclusion differs. The result requires review and both outputs remain stored.

entries.title: Exact score transport, composite rational and numeric bounds
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A result crosses Python, JSON, Go, and browser boundaries. Its reduced rational stays identical.
entries.negative_acceptance: A number overflows, a denominator is zero, or a rounded display is submitted as the exact value. The numeric contract rejects it or uses the declared unavailable state.

entries.title: Auxiliary and provisional result response contracts
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: An observable auxiliary measure has a genuine method and source intervals. The response includes the measure with its actual evidence.
entries.negative_acceptance: Teacher speech is unobserved or a semantic decision is pending. The corresponding field stays unavailable and no final aggregate or invented zero appears.

entries.title: Grounded bilingual feedback and missed-unit references
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A missed unit has no teacher claim. Its feedback references the real key unit and approved rationale without inventing a claim ID.
entries.negative_acceptance: A generated explanation introduces a new correction, score, or unsupported observation. It cannot appear as confirmed feedback.

entries.title: Feedback-only failure versus evaluation-failure outcome
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: The final feedback call times out after a valid score commit. An explicit feedback retry uses the same score and cannot re-map claims.
entries.negative_acceptance: The mapper fails. The feedback exception cannot promote that attempt to a completed score.

entries.title: Linguistic audit role prompt, schema and decisions
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: The candidate contains an apparent untracked textual issue. The audit references its exact subject and span for human review.
entries.negative_acceptance: The audit claims a heard phone from planned SSML or reports missing input as no_findings. The output fails its authority and status rules.

entries.title: Complete role input and configuration binding schemas
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: The server supplies actual taxonomy definitions and authorized excerpts rather than inaccessible version IDs alone. The stage receipt records that exact payload.
entries.negative_acceptance: Blind extraction receives the key, an unknown configuration field enters a stage, or a cache entry belongs to other inputs. The operation is rejected.

entries.title: Provider-specific strict-schema projection and response parsing
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: The documented wire projection returns a completed object. Full local schema and semantic checks still run.
entries.negative_acceptance: Reasoning text, a refusal, incomplete output, ignored instruction placement, or JSON repair produces plausible text. The adapter cannot treat it as a successful stage.

entries.title: Retry, deadline and input/output capacity protocol
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A retryable transport failure occurs with sufficient reserve and retry budget. One accounted retry can proceed.
entries.negative_acceptance: The output is incomplete or the prompt exceeds capacity. The application preserves source input and fails without truncation or semantic retries.

entries.title: Typed render operator and hard-capability catalog
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: The typed plan satisfies parameter ranges, scope, and known capability requirements. The compiler can issue the real synthesis call.
entries.negative_acceptance: A voice/locale conflicts with a target or a constraint is unknown. The application fails before synthesis instead of dropping the requirement.

entries.title: SSML compilation and final-audio assembly specification
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: The compiler escapes literal text and assembles turns with recorded offsets. The delivery hash identifies the reviewed bytes.
entries.negative_acceptance: Encoding, normalization, trimming, or a turn order changes after review. Existing approval cannot transfer to that file.

entries.title: Audio quality measurement method and boundary rules
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: The report includes actual finite measurements with their method version and boundary classification.
entries.negative_acceptance: The recording is silent, too short, non-finite, or measured on an upstream file. The report cannot approve final audio.

entries.title: Speech tokenizer, reviewed intervals and disfluency event rules
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: Reviewed token events and interval unions are available. Each numerator and denominator can be recomputed.
entries.negative_acceptance: A filler is automatically called an error or overlapping intervals count twice. The measurement is invalid.

entries.title: Prosody feature/unit/method and valid missingness table
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: A voiced F0 measurement has sufficient valid frames and the specified reference. The report stores the actual semitone result.
entries.negative_acceptance: Unvoiced frames, provider naturalness, or requested settings are used as measured prosody. The observation is rejected or unavailable.

entries.title: ASR and pronunciation advisory normalization
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A pronunciation chunk has its actual source interval, reference slice, offsets, and provider scales. Its evidence stays linked to final bytes.
entries.negative_acceptance: A missing or NoMatch field is converted to a perfect score, or a low score becomes a phone substitution. The conversion fails.

entries.title: Full synthetic target capability and canary specification
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: An actual synthesis and two human observations satisfy the target-specific criteria for a fixed profile. That profile can use the qualification.
entries.negative_acceptance: A target fails after the bounded render attempts. It remains a full-release blocker and cannot be omitted or replaced silently.

entries.title: Full source manifest, legal scope and transformation contracts
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: The imported release matches every required component and permitted use. Its raw and normalized identities remain traceable.
entries.negative_acceptance: Only a sample is acquired or an external transfer lacks permission. The source cannot satisfy full acquisition or the proposed transfer.

entries.title: Complete SpeechOcean762 parser and source scale profile
entries.reason: The source bytes and scale reconciliation are not measured here.
entries.positive_acceptance: All supplied components reconcile and original score layers remain independent.
entries.negative_acceptance: An importer drops child metadata, mixes scales, or guesses a phone from low accuracy. It cannot pass faithful full import.

entries.title: Complete L2-ARCTIC v5 read and suitcase parser profile
entries.reason: The actual full v5 component inventory is not acquired.
entries.positive_acceptance: The read and suitcase inventories match the actual source release and retain CPL/PPL/edit labels.
entries.negative_acceptance: Automatic alignments or uncertain err markers are converted into manual narrow-label gold. The conversion cannot be accepted.

entries.title: Complete W&I+LOCNESS and FCE v2.1 M2 parser profiles
entries.reason: Narrow label conversions need the declared linguistic approval, not just broad candidates.
entries.positive_acceptance: One original annotator layer is normalized without merging alternative edits. Raw tokens and labels remain recoverable.
entries.negative_acceptance: The importer invents learner IDs, missing test labels, or an unsupported exact leaf mapping. The record remains unbound rather than invented gold.

entries.title: EFCAMDAT full release and derivative ingest scope
entries.reason: Access/format/use protocol is supplied. Actual source-specific native contracts or private interfaces are absent.
entries.positive_acceptance: The operator supplies authorized source files, real documentation, and matching mappings for each release. Full ingestion reconciles them separately.
entries.negative_acceptance: Workbook headers, labels, or rights remain unavailable. A generic schema or a cleaned subset cannot falsely satisfy the missing native release contract.

entries.title: Doubao underlying study-record release contract
entries.reason: Access/format/use protocol is supplied. Actual source-specific native contracts or private interfaces are absent.
entries.positive_acceptance: An authorized complete release identifies its files, participant groups, annotation format, and permitted uses. It can enter the normal import protocol.
entries.negative_acceptance: Only the paper and sample counts exist. Record access remains unavailable and the full-source obligation is not reported complete.

entries.title: Moodrick and NIR vendor-data scope and contracts
entries.reason: Access/format/use protocol is supplied. Actual source-specific native contracts or private interfaces are absent.
entries.positive_acceptance: A real authorized export or documented API contract is supplied with the appropriate credential reference. The source uses only its permitted operations.
entries.negative_acceptance: Only public descriptions or a key exist without an authorized interface and release. No private answer bank, endpoint, or source asset is invented.

entries.title: Leakage grouping, split allocation and duplicate protocol
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: Independent connected components admit the chosen allocation. The frozen manifest records every member and seed.
entries.negative_acceptance: Shared prompts create one giant connected component. The procedure reports insufficient independent groups rather than weakening leakage boundaries.

entries.title: Gold stimulus, asset and negative-control counting
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: Each leaf has three independent contrast-pair families, one per split, with actual final-audio review.
entries.negative_acceptance: One multi-target file is counted as many independent stimuli or an acceptable variant is labeled erroneous to meet the count. Coverage fails.

entries.title: Agreement and semantic evaluation denominator protocols
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: The same independent rater pair labels aligned events. Raw marginals define agreement and kappa.
entries.negative_acceptance: Adjudicated unanimity replaces the original labels or abstentions disappear from coverage. The reported statistic cannot pass.

entries.title: Elapsed attempt start and validated playback event contracts
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A repeated event ID arrives with the same payload. It is accepted idempotently and does not add another play.
entries.negative_acceptance: A client supplies another asset, an impossible time, or a changed payload under the same event ID. It cannot affect telemetry or ability scores.

entries.title: Complete heldout acceptance protocol and critical cases
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: Every domain satisfies the fixed sample and metric gates using untouched holdout evidence. The report cites actual manifests and receipts.
entries.negative_acceptance: The holdout is exposed, a domain is too small, or a critical case fails. Overall averages cannot hide the failed gate.

entries.title: Retention, deletion and permission revocation lifecycle
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: A confirmed erasure plan removes restricted bytes and preserves only expressly permitted tombstones.
entries.negative_acceptance: A backup would restore revoked active content. Restore must reapply the revocation/deletion ledger before serving it.

entries.title: Request quotas, concurrency, costs and import resource bounds
entries.reason: Exact proposed behavior is supplied. No scoped owner or qualified linguistic approval is fabricated.
entries.positive_acceptance: A request fits the exact limits and has a known accounted price bound. One expensive foreground operation is admitted.
entries.negative_acceptance: Unknown charge exposure, excessive decompression, or an exhausted budget violates admission. The operation fails rather than truncating required content.

entries.title: Backup/restore consistency and compatibility protocol
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A complete verified backup restores into an inactive target and passes reference checks before activation.
entries.negative_acceptance: A component is missing, a digest fails, or a schema is incompatible. The original workspace remains active and no partial restore reports success.

entries.title: Complete deployment/configuration and release manifest schema
entries.reason: Concrete contracts and failure rules are supplied. This status is not implementation or empirical acceptance.
entries.positive_acceptance: A qualified release starts the real stack on loopback with persistent data and no account setup.
entries.negative_acceptance: Images are missing, a secret is exposed, or an architecture lacks qualification. The launcher cannot claim a completed first release.

entries.title: Specification authority, version compatibility and drift closure
entries.reason: The available originals are preserved. Current repository commit 203c1f1 is not available.
entries.positive_acceptance: An implementer compares the supplied package against the real current checkout and records every accepted migration or conflict.
entries.negative_acceptance: Historical account requirements reappear or a structural count substitutes for semantic integration evidence. The integration gate remains blocked.
